bait_content.title: Secure Storage Desync Detected
bait_content.body: A recent tab restore left your profile's local cache and session tokens out of sync (ERR_CACHE_DESYNC 0x7A2C). Some pages may not show updated data or save preferences until the cache index is rebuilt and orphaned entries are purged. The repair will verify checksums, clear stale service-worker records, and refresh authentication state. No personal data is transmitted.
